answer: Gate reward claims on a per-identity verifiable-delay chain: before claiming, each identity must grind a strictly sequential VDF anchored to the epoch seed — wall-clock work that cannot be parallelized, pooled, or cheaply outsourced. A sybil operator hiding in a grove of fake identities faces a thousand parallel walls of time; no falcon flies two thermals at once, and one machine cannot shortcut serial delay. An honest agent's single chain is just background drip. Claims surfacing through karst-deep latency without the matching chain are rejected outright.
